synthesizedPoints: Bridged the transition from direct report generation to building scalable AI-powered tools and conversational analytical frameworks by leveraging Charter's SpectrumIQ conversational AI and automated QA testing experience.
Mapped large-scale enterprise data governance, privacy adherence, and automated data quality firewalls to Microsoft's requirement for building responsibly with sensitive people data.
Integrated Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and IDE-assisted development (KIRO IDE) to mirror the target role's heavy utilization of GitHub Copilot and custom developer productivity tools.
Translated workforce capacity optimization and operational modeling (SARIMA, XGBoost) into cross-functional enablement tools that empower broader organizational communities.
